item.title: Southwest Lady Wildcats Post First Win
item.description: All seven players saw action in Tuesday’s game in which the Lady Wildcats of Southwest down Heartland Christian 38 – 32. Scoring for the Wildcats was led by Ally Farr with 9; Timberlynn Palmer was right behind with 8. Coach Laura McCracken reports ‘the girls all played hard as a team, in scoring and defense’.
